purpose: Master orchestration SSIS package for Guidewire PolicyCenter (Source System 3) ETL. Coordinates execution of child extraction packages in foreign-key dependency order, manages audit logging, and provides centralized error handling.
high_level_narrative: The package initiates by logging a 'RUNNING' status to the etl.etl_audit_log table via the CM_DW_PG_Target PostgreSQL connection. It then launches two parallel branches: Extract_Account.dtsx and Extract_Producer.dtsx. Upon completion of both, Extract_Policy.dtsx executes. Subsequently, Extract_Job.dtsx and Extract_Claims.dtsx run in parallel. Extract_Job.dtsx feeds into Extract_PolicyPeriod.dtsx, which then fans out to three parallel packages: Extract_Location.dtsx, Extract_Coverage.dtsx, and Extract_Premium.dtsx. The final stage, Extract_KPI_Aggregates.dtsx, waits for both Extract_Premium.dtsx and Extract_Claims.dtsx to finish. On successful completion of KPI aggregates, the master package updates the audit log to 'COMPLETED'. An OnError event handler captures any failure and presumably logs an error status (though the handler XML is truncated). All child packages execute in-process.
business_domain: Insurance - Policy Administration (Guidewire PolicyCenter) / Data Warehousing ETL
inputs: Child SSIS packages: Extract_Account.dtsx, Extract_Producer.dtsx, Extract_Policy.dtsx, Extract_Job.dtsx, Extract_Claims.dtsx, Extract_PolicyPeriod.dtsx, Extract_Location.dtsx, Extract_Coverage.dtsx, Extract_Premium.dtsx, Extract_KPI_Aggregates.dtsx
outputs: etl.etl_audit_log table (INSERT start record, UPDATE end record)
Execution of child ETL packages (which produce their own outputs)
key_transformations: Orchestration of child package execution in FK-dependent topological order
Audit logging: start timestamp with RUNNING status, end timestamp with COMPLETED status
Parallel execution branching and synchronization points
Centralized error handling via OnError event handler
key_dependencies: SSIS child packages (Extract_*.dtsx) deployed in same project
business_rules: Execution order must respect foreign key dependencies: Account/Producer before Policy; Policy before Job/Claims; Job before PolicyPeriod; PolicyPeriod before Location/Coverage/Premium; Premium and Claims before KPI Aggregates
Audit log entry created at start and updated at completion
Error handling centralized at master package level
